context: User asking whether a dip below support is a real breakdown or stop-hunting by market makers.
user_input_examples: 股价跌破支撑位后快速拉回，是假跌破吗？
是不是被主力扫止损了？

structure.suggestion: Whether to re-enter or stay out
structure.risks: Real breakdown vs fake breakdown confidence

key_principles: Fake breakdowns typically recover within 15-30 minutes on intraday charts
Volume on breakdown should be low; real breakdowns have heavy selling volume
Recovery must breach the breakdown point with conviction (strong candle)
Multiple tests of support weaken it; third test usually breaks for real
Check if stop-loss clusters are visible at obvious technical levels (round numbers, recent lows)

decision_tree.if_breakdown_low_volume_and_quick_recove: Likely stop-hunting, re-enter with tight stop below the wick low
decision_tree.if_breakdown_heavy_volume_and_no_recover: Real breakdown, stay out or short
decision_tree.if_third_test_of_support: Higher probability of real break, reduce position
